title: acer obtusatum var. neapolitanum
intro: Acer obtusatum var. neapolitanum, commonly known as the Neapolitan Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree species in the family Sapindaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer obtusatum var. neapolitanum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and soothe respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
